profile.jobTitle: Controls Software  Engineer  | Pharma · AI/ML · R&D
profile.summary:
🔬 Principal-level Engineer with 12+ years delivering end-to-end automation, embedded systems, and AI/ML solutions across FDA-regulated pharma, radiopharmaceutical, and biomedical manufacturing.
🎓 B.S. Mechatronic Engineering · MBA & Project Management
📍 Chicago, IL · 🌐 English · Spanish · French (C1) · Italian (Technical)
I don't just engineer systems — I own them end-to-end.
From concept to commissioning, I lead projects across the full stack: PLC control systems, custom SCADA platforms, firmware, PCB design, electrical panels, HVAC, pneumatics, and AI-driven process intelligence in FDA-regulated environments applying GMP, cGMP, and 21 CFR Part 11. My systems handle short half-life isotopes (¹⁸F, ⁶⁸Ga, ⁹⁹ᵐTc, ¹⁷⁷Lu) where downtime impacts patient treatment.
⚙️ WHAT I LEAD
▸ AUTOMATION & CONTROLS — PLC (Siemens TIA Portal, Allen-Bradley Studio 5000), all IEC 61131-3 languages, SCL/ST. Full SCADA from scratch. Staubli Robotics (Level I & II). IQ/OQ/PQ, GMP/FDA commissioning.
▸ SCADA & IoT — Production-grade SCADA for Class A cleanrooms using MQTT/Zigbee with patent-pending field controllers. GMP authentication, audit trails, recipe management, cybersecurity.
▸ EMBEDDED & HARDWARE — PCB (Altium, KiCad, Eagle), firmware (ARM Cortex, STM32, ESP32, FPGA, PIC, Nordic), EMI testing, thermal analysis. 5 prototypes of medical-grade biomedical systems.
▸ AI · ML — Python, TensorFlow, OpenCV, Scikit-learn for predictive diagnostics, computer vision, biosignal processing (EEG/ECG/EMG/EOG). MQTT, Zigbee, BLE sensor networks.
▸ LEADERSHIP — Teams of 10+ across NA & Europe. QC coordination through FDA documentation cycles. Full PM: Gantt, risk, KPI/SLA, cross-functional delivery.
🧠 Radiopharmaceuticals · Nuclear Medicine · Pharma · ATMPs · GMP/cGMP · FDA · Automation · Embedded · AI/ML · DAQ · IoT · Robotics
🛠 TIA Portal · Allen-Bradley · Altium · KiCad · SolidWorks · ARM · ESP32 · FPGA · Python · MATLAB · Profinet · MQTT · Zigbee · C · C++ · Docker · Git
🏛 IEEE: Computer Society · Robotics & Automation · Aerospace & Electronic Systems

positions.title: Controls Software  Engineer  | Pharma · AI/ML · R&D
positions.description:
▸ De facto Principal Engineer — end-to-end design and commissioning of integrated systems spanning electrical, pneumatic, mechanical, electronic, HVAC, control, and software across multiple simultaneous high-impact projects

▸ Lead complex multi-site projects across Comecer North America, Italy, and Spain — driving technical decoupling, full regional engineering independence, and international multi-stakeholder delivery simultaneously

▸ Apply PM methodologies end-to-end: Gantt planning, risk management, KPI/SLA definition, and cross-functional stakeholder communication — from concept to validated delivery in FDA-regulated environments

▸ Full GMP, cGMP, and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance — IQ/OQ/PQ validation, SOP development, calibration, and audit-ready documentation for pharma and radiopharmaceutical production

▸ PLC architecture across all IEC 61131-3 languages, SCL/ST specialization, TIA Portal and Allen-Bradley; SCADA, robotics, Profinet, Profibus, Modbus, CANbus, RS232/RS485

▸ Real-time critical systems for ¹⁸F, ⁶⁸Ga, ⁹⁹ᵐTc, ¹⁷⁷Lu — where every minute of downtime impacts radiopharmaceutical supply chains and patient treatment availability

▸ R&D on proprietary systems: reverse-engineering undocumented equipment, live root-cause investigations, and field-validated solutions under critical operational constraints

▸ AI/ML and DAQ systems for predictive diagnostics and process optimization across industrial and regulated manufacturing environments

▸ Full-stack hardware: PCB (Altium, Eagle, KiCAD), firmware (ARM, ESP32, FPGA, PIC, Nordic, Raspberry Pi, Arduino), schematics (AutoCAD Electrical), mechanical design (SolidWorks, Inventor)

▸ Principal-level field engineering across North America — resolving critical failures at nuclear medicine and pharma facilities under extreme time and patient-care pressure

▸ Knowledge transfer and training programs eliminating single-point-of-failure risk on mission-critical FDA-regulated systems

positions.description: Research and development of hardware to manufacture a nanoparticle-filter that inactivates the SARS-CoV-2 virus responsible for the COVID-19 pandemic.
